description: Crypto positioning and macro behind one endpoint — multi-venue perpetual funding and open interest across Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid (largest-open-interest perp per venue, thin venues excluded), order book execution cost, options-implied volatility, ETH exchange whale flows, Bitcoin network health, DeFi TVL, Fear & Greed and dominance, plus the macro regime: Fed funds, 2Y/10Y yields, CPI, dollar index, S&P 500, gold and the catalyst calendar. 17 read-only tools, no API key, live at call time, plus one...
